newsitem.title: USA: CEL-SCI Corp develops new version of HGP-30.
newsitem.headline: CEL-SCI Corp develops new version of HGP-30.

text.p: CEL-SCI Corp said Tuesday it has developed of an improved version of its HGP-30 AIDS vaccine which it hopes will provide better worldwide protection against a large number of HIV subtypes.
The new modified version is called HGP-30W. CEL-SCI said the W stands for worldwide.
The company said even though HIV infection is a major problem in the U.S. and Europe, the developing world has an even greater need for a protective AIDS vaccine.
By focusing on a part of the HIV virus that has fewer mutations, CEL-SCI Corp said it has potentially developed a vaccine with broad application. CEL-SCI said it believes
that HGP-30W will be an important AIDS vaccine candidate for one AIDS vaccine for worldwide use because HGP-30W stimulates the immune system to recognize different HIV subtypes.

"The urgent need of the African and Asian countries for a preventive AIDS vaccine has long been disregarded by the pharmaceutical industry." said CEL-SCI chief executive Geert Kersten. "We hope to be able to address their needs while, at the same time, developing an AIDS vaccine for use in the U.S. and Europe." The company said HGP-30 has been shown to be safe and immunogenic in over 60 volunteers.
